// Blood II's text strings, every one retail's string module (CRes) holds:
// the reference for a mod's Mod\Strings.txt. GENERATED by
// `testBlood2Tables --dump strings` from the built string module; do not
// edit, regenerate. testBlood2Tables proves that loading this file as a
// mod changes nothing.
//
// One `key = "text"` per line: the key is an IDS_ name from
// Shared/ClientRes.h, or the id where the string has no name; the text
// takes \n \r \t \" \\.  %1!s! and the like are the game's inserts:
// keep the ones a string has, or the game reads an argument it never
// passed. A mod copies only the lines it changes. Blood2/Shared/
// BloodModStrings.h has the rest.
